question: Which auxiliary power source does the vehicle concept carry: an integrated APU, a battery-only pack or a trailer genset?
scope: Auxiliary power for a representative ground vehicle concept, at the concept gate.
criteria: OBJ_SILENT_WATCH: at least 8 h of silent watch at 3.5 kW and 49 C ambient
OBJ_SUSTAINMENT_BURDEN: field-maintenance hours per 1,000 operating hours
Before the gate, every option has a completed thermal qualification run and a reliability review of its current technical data
